name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran vowed on 23 Nov to use every means against the US blockade of its ports after Trump threatened blockade runners
state: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei said on 23 Nov Iran would use every means to counter the US naval blockade of its ports, after Trump said on 22 Nov that ships trying to break it would be sunk; UKMTO confirmed a tanker incident in the Gulf of Oman on 22 Nov (Euronews). Bahrain said it intercepted Iranian aerial attacks late on 21 Nov (Gulf News). A Qatari delegation held two hours of talks in Tehran on 20 Nov, which Iran said were not yet formal negotiations (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran, Bahrain and the Gulf states, which can change at short notice. The conflict keeps energy and shipping costs elevated.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping and state-on-state strikes (Bahrain, 21 Nov) = Alert

sources.title: Euronews — Iran vows 'every means' to counter US blockade of Hormuz after Trump threat

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
